card.name: Opening parenthesis giving a clarification
card.fires_on: An opening parenthesis right after a time, temperature or 'recent' phrase, where it introduces a clarification such as 'i.e., within the last 6 months' or the Fahrenheit equivalent.

modes.label: i.e. after recent
modes.description: Parenthesis after 'recent' that defines how recent a test must be.
modes.example: Complete Blood Count Obtain a recent<< (>>i.e., within the last 6

modes.label: Temperature equivalents
modes.description: Parenthesis after a Celsius range that gives the Fahrenheit range.
modes.example: store the diluted solution refrigerated at 2°C to 8°C<< (>>36°F to 46°F

modes.label: Timing qualifier
modes.description: Parenthesis after a timing phrase that gives the exact window.
modes.example: the preoperative dose be given just prior<< (>>1/2 hour to 1 hour

card.writes: It favors words like 'ideal', which suggests it expects a precise or ideal value to be spelled out.
card.plain: It fires on a bracket that opens a clarifying detail after a time or temperature, such as a window or a Fahrenheit conversion.
